IL.source: Prices from EIA: electricity = Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B (residential, year-to-date through Aug 2026); gas = Natural Gas Prices, residential 2025 annual ($/Mcf ÷ 10.37 therms/Mcf). Fixed monthly charges are still PLACEHOLDER (utility tariff not yet looked up).

AZ.source: Prices from EIA: electricity = Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B (residential, year-to-date through Aug 2026); gas = Natural Gas Prices, residential 2025 annual ($/Mcf ÷ 10.37 therms/Mcf). Fixed monthly charges are still PLACEHOLDER (utility tariff not yet looked up).

MA.source: Prices from EIA: electricity = Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B (residential, year-to-date through Aug 2026); gas = Natural Gas Prices, residential 2025 annual ($/Mcf ÷ 10.37 therms/Mcf); oil = EIA weekly Massachusetts No. 2 heating oil residential price, mean of the 2025–26 heating season (Oct–Mar, excl. taxes).
